shots.action: night living room, tree lit with old multicolour string lights. Dad kneels at the wall outlet behind the tree pushing the last plug into an overloaded power strip (already full of plugs); mom stands by the tree feeding him the end of the strand; boy sits on the rug untangling another strand; dog sniffs the cords. ~1.6 s the strip sparks with a pop and a puff of smoke, every light dies; dad jerks back and falls onto his backside, mom drops the strand and covers her mouth, boy scoots back, dog backs away.
shots.camera: handheld from standing height across the room, slight shake; jolts when the sparks go
shots.people: dad (kneeling, front-left), mom (standing behind him), boy (rug), dog
shots.avoid: OMAR_REF analysis: the man looks at the camera with a frozen smile, fist pump, shouted 'Yeah!' (all banned: LG1/LG3)

shots.action: first-person view looking down at own lap (cosy knit sleeves): hands lift the lid of the MerryGlow box; inside: the collapsed ring stack under the conical star topper, the remote and the adapter in their slots; hands lift the stack out by the topper and the rings hang and stretch a little
shots.camera: POV, phone at chest height pointing down at the lap

shots.action: wide room shot: man on a silver step ladder beside a tall UNLIT tree, looking at the tip; he lowers the topper + ring stack onto the tip and lets go; the ~45 thin LED rings slowly unfold down around the tree like an accordion lantern and settle at the base; woman on the sofa watches him with a mug
shots.camera: locked/handheld wide from across the room
shots.people: man on ladder (looking at the tree top), woman on sofa (watching the tree)
shots.product_behaviour: ladder drop + slow fall around the tree (Omar point 5)

shots.animation: pixel steam train with smoke cloud shifting pixel by pixel, wheels cycling, snowflakes twinkling
shots.camera: wide, locked, dark room, tree the only light

shots.animation: pixel snowman face at the bottom with Santa's sleigh and reindeer circling the top, scarf rippling, reindeer legs cycling
shots.camera: medium, lower angle from the side, locked

shots.animation: full-tree crackling fire, flames flickering and rising pixel by pixel
